title: Localize the entire ERP UI to Spanish

requirements.text: Make Spanish the default language for the application UI by replacing hard-coded English strings with Spanish across the navigation, header/search, pages, dialogs, empty states, alerts, and toast messages.
acceptanceCriteria: All visible navigation labels in the sidebar are Spanish (e.g., Dashboard, Inventory, Rates, Sales, Customers, Cashbox, Suppliers, Closures).
Header search button text and the Global Search modal title, placeholder, loading/empty messages, and per-result labels are Spanish.
Inventory page headings, descriptions, buttons (e.g., Add Product), category filter labels (e.g., All Categories), low-stock alert texts, and empty states are Spanish.
Rates page headings, helper texts, form labels, buttons, and toasts (success/error) are Spanish.
Customers list page headings, form labels/placeholders, buttons, empty states, and toasts (success/error) are Spanish.
Customer detail page texts (including error state and the “backend integration required” block) are Spanish.
Placeholder pages (Sales, Cashbox, Suppliers, Closures, Dashboard) have their headings and placeholder/alert copy translated to Spanish.
No user-facing English strings remain in the UI in the modules currently present in the frontend.
All existing functionality (routing, forms, queries, mutations, toasts) continues to work after localization changes.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything in frontend/src/components/ui (immutable paths).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; this change should not require backend schema changes or migrations.
nonGoals: Adding multi-language switching UI (language picker) unless required to meet the Spanish-only request.
Changing business logic, data models, or backend APIs.
Rewriting styling/theme beyond what is necessary to accommodate longer Spanish strings.

preferencesToAdd: App UI should be in Spanish.
